title: 宝塚記念の後に・ミラ、ようやく

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An intense race against T.M. Opera O, Narita Top Road, and Meisho Doto comes to a finish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the competition now behind her, Admire Vega reflects and remembers… racing against rivals is fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, as we discuss our next move, she reminds me of her goal to become someone her sister could be proud of—a goal she wants to achieve for herself, not anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She speaks of becoming a first-magnitude star that shines its light and glory to the furthest reaches of space. That is her goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which means she'll need to take on a race worthy of such merit. So, we decide on the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Admire Vega proceeds forward, not out of devotion or duty, but for what her heart and legs want.
